kurz: Freeze fast, flat and airtight; thaw slowly in the fridge. That keeps structure and flavour intact.
bild_im_kopf: Like a photo with a short exposure: the faster the moment is captured, the sharper the picture.
faustregeln: Flat freezes faster than a block.
schritte: Let cooked food cool first; do not put it in the freezer warm.
Fill bags flat, press out the air, label.
Pre-freeze berries and pieces of dough separately on a tray.
Thaw in the fridge, meat on a plate.
Use thawed food quickly and do not refreeze it raw.
